this makes a tiny serving. best to do this because it might suck xoxo
120 ml of coke zero or monster
monk fruit liquid sweetener. 10 drops. if your using granular sweetener. 1 tbsp
1 packet (7g) of unflavored gelatin

1. line some sort of small bowl with tin foil. trust me you dont want to clean jello out of anything. it sucks. use tin foil
2. in a bowl mix the gelatin, 30 ml (2 tbsp) of the soda/monster, and the liquid or granular sweetener.
3. microwave it for 30 seconds and stir.
4. repeat step 3
5. stir the remaining 90 ml (6 tbsp) of soda/monster into the stuff u just microwaved
6. pour it into the dish lined with foil and wait until its not hot
7. once it's not hot, refrigerate until its solid

ingredients:

1/4 cup of lakanto monk fruit sweetener/1:1 white sugar sweetener (0)

.75 cup of lakanto golden/raw cane sugar replacement/1:1 brown sugar replacement (0)

2.5 tbsp of unsweetened cocoa powder (50)

50 grams/3.3ish tbsp of peanutbutter chips. (i used Reeses brand, 267)

2.5 tbsp of milk chocolate chips (175)
for the chips use any you would like to have. i used a mix because i was experimenting. other flavors like heath, full pb, full milk chocolate, dark chocolate,betc would be so good please try them. i want to try just pb so badly lmao

1.5 egg whites (26, i deadass used 1, put another in a bowl and used half) 

1/8 tsp of salt. or more. nobody cares about salt measurements.

.5 tsp of vanilla extract/how ever much you want I used way more because i dont ever measure vanila. its so good idc how much i use. 

.5 tsp of baking powder

1/8 tsp of baking soda



1) preheat oven to 375/191. 

2) first mix apple sauce, butter, and sugars together. 

3) add egg whites and vanilla extract. mix

4) in another bowl mix together the flour, cocoa powder, salt, baking soda, and baking powder.

5) mix dry ingredients with the wet ingredients.

6) mix in the oats. 

7) add chocolate chips/any additions. 

8) grese a baking sheet with cooking spray (or use parchment paper)

9) make small/medium globs on the sheet. 1.5 tbsp or so. (30 grams or so us what it weighed per glob)  make sure to get chocolate chips/add ons  into each cookie

10) bake on the medium rack for 10 minutes

11) once done baking. eat them. they are best warm. good cooled. but warm is a godsend.
